title: Las tortillas
goal: Buy tortillas at the right hour, because later there are none
culture: Tortillas are made in the morning and they run out. Turn up at eleven and the answer is ya se acabaron, and the fix is not to complain but to ask her to put some aside for you tomorrow.

beats.objective: Ask whether there are any left
beats.good: ¿Todavía hay? asks whether any are left, which is a different question from whether she sells them. Here it is the one that matters.

beats.es: Uy, no. Ya se acabaron, mi amor. Desde las diez.
beats.objective: Say it back to be sure you understood
beats.good: Se acabaron — they are finished. Repeating it back as a question is how you check you heard it, and she will tell you when to come instead.

beats.es: Sí pues. Venga mañana temprano, como a las seis.
beats.good: Temprano at a tortillería means six. Anything in this market worth queueing for is gone by ten and nobody thinks that is early.

beats.objective: Ask her to put some aside
beats.good: Guárdeme asks her to put some by for you, and asking is the whole difference between a customer and a regular.
